This airborne or shipborne geophysical survey recorded the following parameters: Total Field Magnetic, Vertical Gradient of TF. The flight line spacing is 300 m for a total of 6741 kilometres. The survey was flown between 1976-10-23 and 1976-11-26. The data were Digitally acquired. Platform: Fixed-wing.
